decisions.reason: As a flagship product line that is very close to the firm's core dental software and supported by its own R&D, it fits existing knowledge well and is highly improvable through learning from early market feedback.

The education institute extends the firm's established training and practitioner-facing capabilities, so its relatedness to existing knowledge makes continued refinement and commercial use more likely than withdrawal.

The remote support tool complements the firm's software, support, and integration strengths, and because it builds on familiar capabilities the firm is likely to retain it and improve it rather than remove it.
